intro: The Bristleback Attack Plans are crude maps and tactical notes drafted by the quilboar of Brambleblade Ravine. They outline a coordinated siege aimed directly at overrunning the tauren settlement of Camp Narache.

p: Hidden deep within a dirt cave in Brambleblade Ravine, these scribbled tactical sketches reveal that the Bristleback quilboar are no longer just skirmishing on the borders of the Red Cloud Mesa. Instead, their leadership planned an organized, sustained assault to push into Camp Narache and wipe out the young tauren training there. Delivering this map to Chief Hawkwind allows the tribe to send word to Bloodhoof Village for reinforcements, blunting the impending invasion before it can begin.
